prevention_rule: Before a material Portal V2 promotion, synchronize the single candidate head with current main, bind PR metadata to the authoritative base, require exact-head Netlify preview evidence, and carry Brain learning, development ledger, and human change documentation in the same lineage.

evidence.outcome: Netlify preview build recovered after synchronizing the portal candidate with current main.
